key_results: SHAPformer achieves 50–1000× speedup vs. PermutationSHAP (exact explanations <1 s); identifies past target as key predictor; detects Christmas load anomalies on real electrical data
comments: Clever attention-based trick eliminates sampling, yielding exact SHAP values efficiently; performance on synthetic data is strong, but evaluation on real-world forecasting tasks is limited to two datasets.

model_io.model: Transformer + attention manipulation for feature-subset predictions + Shapley value computation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Attention manipulation enables sampling-free SHAP; Transformer architecture provides interpretable 50–1000× speedup vs. PermutationSHAP
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: exact explanations computed <1 s; ground-truth feature importances recovered on synthetic data

title: AFM imaging reveals the unreconstructed α‑Al2O3(0001) surface to be inhomogeneous and rough
task: Resolve atomic structure of unreconstructed α-Al₂O₃(0001) surface via high-resolution AFM and DFT
key_results: Nc-AFM reveals rough, inhomogeneous (1×1) surface with only nanometer-scale ordered Al-terminated regions; (1×1) is metastable relative to (√31×√31)R±9° reconstruction; undercoordinated Al cations remain despite relaxation
comments: Challenges conventional understanding of alumina surface chemistry; reconciles conflicting observations but raises questions about whether reported (1×1) structure truly exists as a stable phase.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unreconstructed (1×1) surface is atomically flat and uniform; undercoordinated Al cations sufficiently relax to stabilize the structure
hypotheses.result: Refuted: AFM reveals nanometer-scale disorder and roughness; DFT confirms metastability relative to (√31×√31)R±9° reconstruction

title: Altermagnetic type-II multiferroics with Néel-order-locked electric polarization
task: Demonstrate type-II multiferroicity in altermagnetic materials
key_results: Eight distinct Néel-order-to-polarization locking categories identified; monolayer MgFe2N2 achieves altermagnetic multiferroicity with spontaneous electric polarization
comments: Bridges two emerging paradigms (altermagnetism and type-II multiferroics) but relies on first-principles prediction rather than experimental confirmation of the proposed magneto-optical detection method.

model_io.model: symmetry analysis + metal-ligand model + first-principles DFT

hypotheses.hypothesis: Altermagnetic Néel order generates spontaneous electric polarization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via symmetry analysis and first-principles calculations for MgFe2N2

title: Accelerated discovery of Cr-based A2+B2 superalloys across 11 elements with a deep-learning CALPHAD surrogate
task: Accelerate discovery of Cr-based A2+B2 superalloys via deep-learning CALPHAD surrogate
key_results: Deep-NN surrogate achieves 10,000× speedup over CALPHAD; screened >10⁸ compositions in 11-element space; 6/8 synthesized alloys homogenize to single-phase A2; 3/8 form intended A2+B2 microstructure; VEC and rice parameter correlate with ductility
comments: Impressive materials discovery pipeline combining ML acceleration with experimental validation; 75% phase prediction accuracy is reasonable but sensitivity near A2–B2 boundary reveals practical limitations of surrogate models.

model_io.model: deep neural network CALPHAD surrogate + thermodynamic screening + targeted synthesis

hypotheses.hypothesis: NN surrogate enables 10,000× speedup; VEC and Rice parameter predict ductility via d-state Fermi-level effects
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: surrogate matches CALPHAD to <2% error; 75% synthesis success; increasing VEC improves ductility via Rice intrinsic ductility parameter

title: Modeling quantum geometry for fractional Chern insulators with unsupervised learning
task: Model quantum geometry of fractional Chern insulators using unsupervised learning
key_results: VAE-based framework distinguishes FCI and non-FCI states; generates novel form factors with distinct topological character; PCA reveals components with approximately quantized Chern numbers
comments: Creative application of VAE and PCA to FCI form factors; latent-space interpolation to discover unobserved phases (e.g., charge density waves) is intriguing but requires theoretical validation.

model_io.model: VAE + PCA on single-particle form factors
inputs: interacting Hamiltonian form factors for FCIs
outputs: PCA components with quantized Chern numbers

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unsupervised learning on form factor distributions captures topological structure; latent space enables discovery of unobserved many-body phases
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: VAE distinguishes FCI/non-FCI; generates novel phases including CDW states not in training set

title: Impact of nonlocal Coulomb repulsion on superconductivity and density-wave orders in bilayer nickelates
task: Investigate impact of nonlocal Coulomb repulsion on superconductivity and density-wave orders in bilayer nickelates
key_results: Interlayer intra-orbital repulsion suppresses s±-wave pairing and SDW, promoting inter-orbital d_{x²−y²}-wave pairing; interlayer inter-orbital repulsion enhances s±-wave via increased interlayer charge fluctuations; intralayer nearest-neighbor repulsion favors (π,π) CDW
comments: FRG study reveals complex interplay of nonlocal interactions in bilayer nickelates; however, predicted d_{x²−y²} pairing critical scale is higher than observed Tc, questioning its role in high-Tc superconductivity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Nonlocal Coulomb repulsion modulates pairing symmetry in bilayer nickelates; interlayer inter-orbital repulsion enhances interlayer s±-wave via charge fluctuations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: inter-orbital d_{x²−y²} promoted by intra-orbital repulsion; s±-wave enhanced by inter-orbital repulsion; (π,π) CDW promoted by intralayer NN repulsion

title: Reconstruction of magnon eigenfunctions by X-ray magnetic vector chronoscopy
task: Reconstruct magnon eigenfunctions via time-resolved resonant X-ray scattering
key_results: Direct measurement of nanoscale magnon vectorial eigenfunctions in synthetic antiferromagnet; angular resolution 0.1° (±0.01%); access to non-Hermitian Hamiltonian and complex-valued coupling strengths
comments: Novel experimental technique combining time-resolved X-ray scattering with magnon tomography; demonstration on a model system (NiFe/Ru/CoFeB multilayer) is instructive but scope is limited to this geometry.

model_io.model: time-resolved resonant X-ray scattering (XMVC) on synthetic antiferromagnet

hypotheses.hypothesis: XMVC reconstructs full magnetization dynamics with 0.1° angular resolution, revealing magnon eigenfunctions and non-Hermitian Hamiltonian
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: magnon state tomography achieved; hybridized modes characterized via direct eigenfunction measurement

title: Electron matter waves with internal torque
task: Generate electron matter waves with ultrafast internal torque via chiral light interaction
key_results: Chiral laser creates discrete energy sidebands via helical photon absorption; rest-mass dispersion converts sidebands to wavefunction with femtosecond internal torque; local chirality evolves from left-handed to right-handed
comments: Creative quantum optics approach combining vortex beams and electron rest-mass dispersion; femtosecond timescale and picometre localization are impressive but practical utility for atomic/subatomic angular momentum control remains to be demonstrated.

model_io.model: electron beam + chiral laser interaction + rest-mass dispersion

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chiral laser creates energy-OAM correlation; rest-mass dispersion converts this to internal wavefunction torque
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: discrete energy sidebands created; femtosecond chirality evolution demonstrated

title: Engineering turbulence resilience in Bessel-Vortex beams through partial coherence and topological charge pairing
task: Engineer turbulence resilience in dual partially coherent Bessel-Vortex beams via topological charge pairing
key_results: Co-signed topological charge pairs show monotonically increasing resilience with charge difference; counter-signed pairs exhibit non-monotonic response with minimum resistance at Δm=8; equal-magnitude opposite charges show monotonic degradation
comments: Innovative exploitation of topological charge combinations for atmospheric beam propagation; real-time holographic generation of partially coherent structured beams is a notable technical achievement.

model_io.model: SLM-based beam generation + turbulence chamber propagation + scintillation measurement

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dual topological charge pairing provides previously unexplored control over turbulence resilience beyond single-beam or partial-coherence methods
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: non-monotonic and monotonic resilience patterns observed depending on charge sign pairing

title: Optimization of Material and Bandgap Engineering for Distinctive Layers in Perovskite Solar Cells
task: Optimize perovskite solar cell layer materials and bandgaps for high efficiency
key_results: Power conversion efficiency 27.12% with Jsc=25.34 mA/cm², Voc=1.196 V, FF=89.50% using optimized CH₃NH₃PbI₃ and MASnBr₃/Cd₀.₅Zn₀.₅S stack
comments: Achieves respectable efficiency via systematic material screening but lacks experimental validation and does not exceed state-of-the-art published results for perovskite–perovskite or perovskite–silicon tandems.

inputs: layer thicknesses (ZnO 300 nm, Cd₀.₅Zn₀.₅S 50 nm, perovskite 850 nm, MASnBr₃ 350 nm)

hypotheses.hypothesis: CH₃NH₃PbI₃ offers optimal bandgap for light absorption; MASnBr₃/Cd₀.₅Zn₀.₅S ETL/HTL pairing maximizes device performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed numerically: 27.12% PCE achieved

title: Soliton dynamics in the stochastic nonlinear Schrödinger equation with self-phase modulation and multiplicative white noise
task: Derive analytical soliton solutions to stochastic nonlinear Schrödinger equation with noise
key_results: Improved modified extended tanh function method yields bright/dark solitons, singular/periodic structures, Jacobi and Weierstrass elliptic function solutions under multiplicative white noise
comments: Systematic analytical approach to noisy NLS; graphical analysis covers various noise regimes but lacks rigorous stability analysis or comparison with numerical simulations of the noisy dynamics.

model_io.model: improved modified extended tanh method + stochastic perturbation analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Analytical tanh-based method provides exact solutions to noisy NLS; solutions exhibit persistent structure under stochastic perturbations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: rich spectrum of soliton and periodic solutions derived; graphical analysis shows structure robustness across noise regimes

title: Frequency selective surface based triple band multi slotted MIMO antenna for sub-6 GHz wireless applications
task: Design compact multiband MIMO antenna for sub-6 GHz 5G and beyond
key_results: Triple-band operation (3.4, 6.68, 8.4 GHz) with 12–14 dBi gain; envelope correlation coefficient <0.5 indicating good diversity
comments: Standard antenna engineering work with incremental improvements via FSS; design is practical but not particularly novel in the context of multiband MIMO literature.

outputs: MIMO metrics (ECC, DG, CCL, TARC, MEG)

hypotheses.hypothesis: FSS layer placement enhances gain and reduces surface waves
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 12–14 dBi gain achieved with improved isolation

title: Local expansion mechanisms for quantum-scale wormholes
task: Model enlargement of Planck-scale wormholes to macroscopic size
key_results: Local inflation bubble mechanism magnifies microscopic wormhole structures; required stress-energy determined via Einstein equations; intrinsic lower bounds on energy density obtained
comments: Theoretical toy model extending Morris–Thorne–Yurtsever proposal; relies on exotic matter and remains speculative without addressing observational signatures or quantum gravity constraints.

model_io.model: general relativity (Einstein equations) in de Sitter background

hypotheses.hypothesis: Local inflation bubble can enlarge microscopic wormholes via controlled vacuum expansion
hypotheses.result: Model construction feasible; energy density lower bounds determined via Einstein equations

title: Enhanced optical response of chalcone doped methyl cellulose polymer films for optoelectronic applications
task: Enhance optical properties of polymer films via chalcone doping
key_results: Red shift in absorption edge and band gap reduction with increasing dopant (0–2 wt%); ionic conductivity ~10⁻⁵ S/cm
comments: Demonstrates structure–property relationships in doped polymers but reports modest ionic conductivity, suggesting limited electronic applications without further optimization.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chalcone doping modulates optical band gap without significantly affecting ionic transport
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: progressive band gap narrowing; conductivity ~10⁻⁵ S/cm unchanged

title: Sacrificial polyvinyl alcohol substrates to transfer atomic layer deposition grown dielectric thin films
task: Develop sacrificial PVA substrates for transferring ALD-grown dielectric films
key_results: 32 nm continuous Al₂O₃ films transferred over millimeter scales with angstrom-scale roughness; maximum processing temperature 226 °C identified; residual PVA-derived carbon contamination observed
comments: Practical advancement in transfer printing, but carbon contamination limits dielectric quality—identified as a critical unresolved issue that must be addressed for practical adoption.

model_io.model: ALD on PVA + thermal analysis + wet exfoliation

hypotheses.hypothesis: PVA substrates enable easy film exfoliation; carbon contamination from PVA limits transferred film quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: films transfer intact but residual carbon reduces dielectric properties

title: Radar-assisted wireless sensor communications using frequency-modulated reconfigurable intelligent surfaces
task: Demonstrate radar-assisted wireless sensor communication via frequency-coded reconfigurable intelligent surfaces
key_results: Error-free frame reception up to 10 m (static) and 4 m (moving); packet error rate <0.1%; symbol duration 250 ms; no active RF transmission from tag
comments: Clever integration of 24 GHz CW radar with RIS backscatter for low-data-rate IoT; practical demonstration is strong, though data rate and range are modest compared to standard wireless protocols.

model_io.model: 24 GHz CW radar + programmable RIS (4 unit cells with PIN diodes) + digital control

hypotheses.hypothesis: Frequency-coded backscatter via RIS modulation enables data embedding and recovery from baseband sidebands, robust to Doppler offsets
hypotheses.result: Confirmed experimentally: error-free reception up to 10 m with PER <0.1%

title: A High-resolution metal–insulator–metal plasmonic biosensor with concentric ring resonators for carcinoembryonic antigen detection
task: Design high-resolution MIM plasmonic biosensor for carcinoembryonic antigen detection
key_results: Sensitivity 1035 nm/RIU, resonance linewidth 3.75 nm, figure of merit 276 RIU⁻¹ using concentric ring resonators
comments: Solid FDTD-based resonator design with good sensitivity metrics; practical robustness is assessed numerically but not experimentally validated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Optimized concentric ring geometry maximizes field confinement and coupled resonances for enhanced sensitivity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: achieved 1035 nm/RIU sensitivity via structural optimization

title: Transparent conducting electrodes for perovskite–silicon tandem solar cells
task: Review material requirements and candidates for transparent conducting electrodes in perovskite–silicon tandem solar cells
key_results: Identifies essential TCE properties: optical transmittance, electrical conductivity, chemical stability; highlights indium-based oxides as current standard; discusses emerging alternatives and computational/experimental advances
comments: Comprehensive review bridging materials science and device engineering; establishes clear design rules but does not report new experimental data or propose genuinely novel TCE materials.

inputs: TCE candidate materials (ITO, AZO, gallium-doped zinc oxide, etc.)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Indium-based oxides are necessary for current high-efficiency tandems; non-indium alternatives require substantial advances to match performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: ITO remains standard; alternative materials show promise but face trade-offs in transmittance, conductivity, or stability

title: AI-assisted label-free single-particle analysis of milk-derived extracellular vesicles enabled by nanotweezers
task: Enable label-free single-particle analysis of milk-derived extracellular vesicles
key_results: Parallel trapping of thousands of mEVs; size and refractive index determination from Brownian motion and interferometric contrast without chemical labels
comments: Innovative integration of nanotrapping, imaging, and AI; the AI role is somewhat understated—clearer details on the learning architecture would strengthen the contribution.

model_io.model: electrohydrodynamic nanotweezer + interferometric imaging + AI analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Parallel nanotrapping enables rapid, label-free characterization of mEV populations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: thousands of vesicles trapped and analyzed in seconds via Brownian motion and interferometric scattering
